page_title: Vicuna: An Open-Source Chatbot Impressing GPT-4 with 90%* ChatGPT Quality

sources.entry: Vicuna - A powerful open-source model fine-tuned from LLaMA, designed to be conversational and responsive, similar to ChatGPT. Vicuna is available for local deployment, allowing developers to create customized AI applications with private and secure local execution.
Vicuna-13B - An open-source chatbot trained by fine-tuning LLaMA on user-shared conversations collected from ShareGPT. #free

summary.name: Vicuna
summary.one_liner: Vicuna-13B is an open-source chatbot created by fine-tuning Meta's LLaMA on about 70K user-shared ChatGPT conversations from ShareGPT.
use_cases: Running a conversational AI model locally or privately
Comparing chatbot quality with GPT-4 based evaluation
Low-cost training of a chat model
summary.what_it_does: The page introduces Vicuna-13B, a chatbot fine-tuned from a LLaMA base model on roughly 70K ShareGPT conversations, with training adjusted for multi-turn dialogue and a 2048-token context. The team reports training cost around $300 for the 13B model, using SkyPilot managed spot instances to cut expenses. A preliminary evaluation used GPT-4 as a judge on 80 questions, claiming Vicuna reaches about 90% of ChatGPT and Bard quality and beats LLaMA and Alpaca in over 90% of cases, though the authors call this non-rigorous. The page also describes a multi-model serving system, a public online demo, and release of code (on GitHub, FastChat) and Vicuna-13B weights, but not the dataset.
notable: Fine-tuned from LLaMA on about 70K user-shared ChatGPT conversations from ShareGPT
Reported training cost around $300 for 13B using SkyPilot spot instances
GPT-4 used as an automated judge in preliminary evaluation
Code under Apache 2.0; weights and demo for non-commercial use
caveats: Online demo and model are for non-commercial use only, subject to LLaMA license, OpenAI data terms and ShareGPT privacy practices
Evaluation is preliminary and non-rigorous; weaker at reasoning, math and coding
